title.en: Know what happens to an unhandled exception with finally

say.en: Whether the experiment works or fails, you still wash the test tubes. finally is the code that runs no matter what. In this lesson: Use finally for clean-up.
Trace try-except-else-finally.
Know what happens to an unhandled exception with finally.

body.en: A try statement can end with a *finally* clause. Its statements execute every time: when the try succeeds, when an exception is caught, and even when the exception is not handled. It is placed after all except clauses and the else clause, and is commonly used to close files or release resources. If the exception is not handled, finally runs first and then the exception is passed on.

points.en: Runs whether or not an exception occurs
Unhandled exception: *finally* runs, then the exception is re-raised

say.en: A try statement can end with a finally clause. Its statements execute every time: when the try succeeds, when an exception is caught, and even when the exception is not handled. It is placed after all except clauses and the else clause, and is commonly used to close files or release resources. title.en: On the board: finally always runs

say.en: finally comes after all the except and else clauses.
With s equal to 12, there is no exception: else prints C, then finally prints D.
With s equal to 12a, int fails: except prints B, then finally prints D.
Even when an exception is not caught, or the function returns from try, finally still runs first. It is used to close files and release resources.

narration.en: We trace three cases through try, except, else and finally, and see that finally runs in every one.

say.en: We trace three cases through try, except, else and finally, and see that finally runs in every one.

prompt.en: try: print("A"); x = 1 / 0; print("B") — except ZeroDivisionError: print("C") — else: print("D") — finally: print("E") — then print("F"). Put what happens in order.
prompt.kn: try: print("A"); x = 1 / 0; print("B") — except ZeroDivisionError: print("C") — else: print("D") — finally: print("E") — ನಂತರ print("F"). ಘಟನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡಿ.

steps.en: 1 / 0 raises ZeroDivisionError, so print("B") is skipped
The matching except clause prints C
else is skipped because an exception occurred
The program carries on and prints F

explanation.en: The output is A, C, E, F. Once an exception is raised the rest of try is skipped; the matching handler runs; else runs only when there was no exception; finally always runs; then the program continues.
explanation.kn: ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ A, C, E, F. ವಿನಾಯಿತಿಯ ನಂತರ try ನ ಉಳಿದ ಭಾಗ ಬಿಡಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ; finally ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: Give the exact output of this program.

answer.en:
Result: 4.0
Done with 8 2
Cannot divide by zero
Done with 8 0

narration.en: Two calls: one succeeds, one fails. Notice that the finally line appears both times.

say.en: Two calls: one succeeds, one fails. Notice that the finally line appears both times. Give the exact output of this program.
def divide(a, b).
try.
r equals a divided by b.
except ZeroDivisionError.
print("Cannot divide by zero").
else.
print("Result:", r).
finally.
print("Done with", a, b).
divide(8, 2).
divide(8, 0).

So the answer is Result: 4.0
Done with 8 2
Cannot divide by zero
Done with 8 0.
